query:
MATCH p1 = (c:Container)<-[:GenericAll]-(b:Base)
WHERE c.distinguishedname STARTS WITH 'CN=System Management,CN=System,'
OPTIONAL MATCH p2 = (:Base)-[:MemberOf*..]->(b)
RETURN p1,p2
name: SCCM Principals with Full Control of System Management Container (Possible Site Servers)
description: Display every AD principal holding Full Control over the System Management container, plus the nested group memberships that inherit it - SCCM publishes its site and management point objects under this container, so these principals are candidate site servers and can tamper with SCCM's AD-published configuration
